name: Optimal Linear Volumetric Predictor with Truncated Huffman Coding
aliases: 差值编码与霍夫曼编码结合
definition: A lossless compression method for 3D volume data that uses a causal linear predictor to estimate voxel values based on previous voxels, calculates the difference (error) between the actual and predicted values, and encodes these differences using a truncated Huffman code. It assumes wide-sense stationarity to derive optimal predictor coefficients via the Yule-Walker equations.
summary: This lossless compression algorithm for 3D volume data predicts voxel values from neighbors and encodes residuals with truncated Huffman coding, using optimal linear coefficients to outperform generic compressors.
